status.claim.paidTimeout: Paid: the shop did not answer
status.claim.paidArbiter: Paid: the arbiter decided for you
status.claim.paidStale: Paid: the arbiter did not decide in time
lang.label: Language
meta.title: Kekal: a warranty that outlives the shop
meta.description: Kekal holds a shop's warranty money on Solana. If the shop stops answering a claim, the buyer is paid. If the shop goes silent, every holder is paid.
meta.ogAlt: Kekal: a warranty that outlives the shop. Three rules beside a sample warranty card showing a 25.00 kUSD reserve and a copper stamp marked Paid because the shop went silent.
home.lede: The shop's promise to install and service what it sold, backed by money it cannot take back while your warranty runs.
home.rule.silent: Shop silent on your claim: you are paid.
home.rule.gone: Shop goes quiet for good: every holder is paid.
home.rule.expired: Warranty ends: the reserve goes back to the shop.
card.title: Warranty card
card.sample.note: Sample card. The live demo issues a real one to your browser.
home.title: A warranty that outlives the shop
warranty.shopSilent: The shop went silent on {date}. Every card it issued is paid from its reserve.
warranty.activatedOn: Activated on a buyer's phone on {date}.
warranty.notActivated: Not activated yet. Until the first scan, the shop that printed this card can still act on it.
next.settleUnanswered: If the shop does not answer by {time}, the reserve is paid to the card holder.
next.closeStale: If nobody takes this further by {time}, the claim closes and the warranty carries on.
next.settleStaleDispute: If the arbiter does not decide by {time}, the reserve is paid to the card holder.
next.declareDormant: The shop must check in by {time}. If it does not, it is marked silent and every holder is paid.
next.claimOrphan: The shop went silent, so the reserve can be paid to the card holder now.
next.releaseExpired: On {time} this warranty ends and the reserve goes back to the shop.
terms.heading: The shop's promise
terms.match: This text matches the fingerprint recorded when the warranty was issued.
terms.mismatch: This text does not match the fingerprint recorded when the warranty was issued. Ask the shop for the original terms.
terms.missing: The terms text is not kept on this site. Its fingerprint is in the technical details; ask the shop for the text.
timeline.heading: What has happened
event.HolderTransferred: Card moved to a new phone
event.ReservePaid: Reserve paid to the card holder
event.WarrantyReleased: Warranty ended, reserve returned to the shop
tech.intro: Kekal runs on the Solana blockchain (devnet). The card is a bearer key, not a wallet you sign up for; the reserve is a kUSD token held by the Kekal program until it is paid out or returned.
missing.bad_address.title: That is not a warranty address
missing.bad_address.body: Check the link, or type the address printed under the code on the card.
missing.not_found.title: No warranty at this address
missing.not_found.body: Nothing Kekal issued lives here. The card may belong to a different network, or the address has a typo.
missing.network.title: We could not reach the network
missing.network.body: Your warranty is not affected: the reserve stays locked whether or not this page loads. Try again in a minute.
panel.readOnly: Read-only view. To act on this warranty, open the link from the card itself.
panel.unactivated: This card is not activated yet. Activating moves it to this phone: after that, the printed code no longer controls the warranty.
panel.taken: This card was already activated on another phone. If that was not you, take the card back to the shop.
panel.saveCard: Save this link now. It is your card from here on; anyone with it can act on the warranty.
panel.confirm: The shop fixed it: close the claim
panel.escalate: Not fixed: send to the arbiter
settle.settleUnanswered.body: The shop did not answer in time. Anyone may now pay the card holder.
settle.settleStaleDispute.body: The arbiter did not decide in time. Anyone may now pay the card holder.
settle.claimOrphan.body: The shop went silent. Anyone may now pay the card holder.
settle.declareDormant.body: The shop missed its check-in. Anyone may now mark it silent, which lets every holder be paid.
settle.closeStale.body: The time to take this claim further has passed. Anyone may now close it.
settle.releaseExpired.body: This warranty has ended. Anyone may now return the reserve to the shop.
settle.releaseExpired.button: Return the reserve to the shop
claim.heading: Make a claim
claim.description: Describe it in a few words
claim.privacy: Only a fingerprint of this text is recorded publicly. Tell the shop the details too.
send.heading: Money paid to you
send.badAddress: That address is not valid. Copy it again from the app that will receive the money.
send.badAmount: Enter an amount above zero and no more than the balance.
error.rate_ip: Too many requests from this network in the last hour. Try again later.
error.rate_holder: This card has sent many requests in the last hour. Try again later.
error.rate_global: The site has reached today's limit of free requests. Try again tomorrow.
error.network: We could not reach the network. Nothing was sent; try again.
error.failed_on_chain: The step was refused, usually because someone else acted first. The page will show the latest state.
error.activation_pending: We could not confirm the activation yet. The new card key is kept on this phone: reload this page in a minute and it will show the new card link if the activation went through.
error.not_confirmed: Sent, but not confirmed yet. Reload the page in a minute to see if it went through.
error.relayer_unavailable: Actions are paused on this site right now. The warranty and its reserve are unaffected.
error.generic: Something went wrong and nothing was sent. Try again.
check.title: Check a warranty
check.lede: Paste the address or the link from a warranty card to see its reserve, deadline and history.
check.label: Warranty address or card link
check.bad: That does not look like a warranty address. It is a long code of letters and numbers.
check.keyNote: If you paste a card link, its private part stays on this device and the page opens read-only.
error.send_failed: The network refused this step, usually because it is not due yet by the network's clock or someone acted first. Wait a few seconds and try again.
